correct_completion: its deeper meaning only appears after several readings.
full_sentence: Although the poem seems simple at first, its deeper meaning only appears after several readings.
acceptable_variants: its meaning becomes clear only after several readings.

options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, not a contrast; after 'although' the clause must oppose the first part of the sentence.

options.text: its deeper meaning only appears after several readings.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must present a point that contrasts with the first part of the sentence. Portuguese speakers may be tempted to use a result pattern here because Portuguese often links clauses with similar connectors, but English 'although' always signals contrast.
translation: Embora o poema pareça simples à primeira vista, seu significado mais profundo só aparece depois de várias leituras.
